fieldValues.title: An owner act is the last step of its work
fieldValues.move: When the owner affirms, answers, receives or ratifies, that act completes the work it judged: the merge, close or release that follows runs from it, by the agent under the merge rule (decision mode and door), not as a second visit to GitHub.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Work whose door or mode needs the owner's merge in its own right.
fieldValues.falsifier: A week after it is in force, the owner still merges most practice PRs by hand.
